$comment: Hand-picked seeds. These are ALWAYS evaluated, whatever the search API returns, because they are the tools readers actually ask about. Membership still has to pass the quality gates in thresholds.json — seeding guarantees evaluation, not inclusion. Add repos here via PR.

seeds.why: Drive Claude Code / Codex from a phone with end-to-end encryption.
Orchestrate several coding agents from desktop and mobile; easier on-ramp than Orca.
Run a fleet of parallel agents, each on your own subscription.
One place for every agent's model; pools accounts and reroutes models.
The incumbent all-in-one provider/account switcher for Claude Code, Codex and friends.
Turn upstream AI subscriptions into a metered, rate-limited, billable relay.
Open-source terminal agent with broad provider support.
Gemini's terminal agent, generous free tier.
